name: ClickFold Plastics
old_description: All we need is a sketch, CAD file, mock-up, or the internal components to design your part or product. We can also reverse-engineer injection molded parts, or sheet metal housings.
about:
ClickFold Plastics was founded in 2001 in Charlotte, North Carolina, to address a gap in the market for custom plastic enclosures and parts in smaller volumes. The company developed a zero-tooling fabrication process that eliminates the need for expensive molds, targeting industrial buyers who previously had to choose between off-the-shelf enclosures, costly injection molding, or sheet metal fabrication.

The company produces custom plastic housings, enclosures, covers, panels, and similar components using CNC machining, 3D printing, digital graphics, UV printing, EMI shielding, assembly, and packaging services. Its facility straddles the North Carolina–South Carolina border near Charlotte Douglas International Airport, operates multiple shifts in an air-conditioned, smoke-free environment, and focuses on just-in-time delivery for low-volume production runs.

ClickFold serves OEMs across industrial controls, medical devices, communications, gaming and simulators, building controls, measuring equipment, government and military, and commercial vehicles. Customers receive virtual 3D prototypes for review before physical first articles are produced using the same materials and processes as final production.

The zero-tooling approach allows cost-effective low-volume manufacturing with no minimum order quantities and a typical concept-to-production timeline of under four weeks. The quality system has been ISO 9001 certified since 2017, and the company maintains international production-transfer partnerships with firms in Germany and Brazil, as well as collaborations with local universities.
